notes.title: New Update Live: Power Fixes and Auto Turrets
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



A fresh update for the Trainfort alpha is live. This patch improves stability, fixes network issues, and adds a brand new way to defend your base: automatic gun turrets.


Here’s what changed:
Power grid connectors revamped for easier setups

Bug fixes for electrical devices

Network errors fixed

Network synchronization optimized

Automatic gun turrets can now be crafted!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517724/0d23a96392bf4a0597fa1aa01edd25ebba12c6fa.gif"]



If you run into problems or just want to compare, the old version is still available on the Steam beta branch.



We’d love to hear your feedback: is the game running more stable? Does the turret help or just add more chaos? Your feedback keeps shaping Trainfort with every update!



And by the way: we’ve really enjoyed seeing how many of you joined our community on Discord, shared feedback, and posted your screenshots and videos from the alpha. Keep them coming! Share your best adventures with the new turret and you might see them featured on our socials and win a special Discord title!



Thanks again for playing! See you on the road! 🚂

~The Trainfort Team

notes.title: Thanks, Updates and Experimental Changes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First off, huge thanks to all of you who’ve jumped into the Trainfort alpha and shared your feedback so far: it really means the world to the all team. Based on your enthusiasm, we decided to keep the playtest open for now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517724/9006c8a40d0a4347cf6bedccf395a5d1159a5a45.gif

With that decision comes also a new update with a batch of improvements and fixes, including:


 Battery packs now have an indicator
 Machines now have 2 buttons for packing
 Steam generator fuel consumption fixed
 Various power grid fixes
 Minor tweaks to machines
 Character now bound to Steam ID instead of nickname
 Teleport to spawn if you get stuck
 Resource container can now be packed
 Journal no longer spams new entry notifications
 Cartridge decoder now alerts if data was already extracted

But that’s not all…

Based on feedback, we implemented one experimental change we’d love your thoughts on. We noticed players were squatting a lot to pick up items, which could get tiring for some. So with the change now you can pick up things off the ground without crouching! You’ll still need to squat sometimes, just not as often 

Let us know what you think in the comment section below or on Discord here! 

Thanks again! See you on the road!

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix #1 is live!
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that did not allow to craft the locomotive
- Fixed the screen on the Data Cards. Now it correctly shows the blueprint inside
- Holding items in place on the base foundation is now more stable
- Improved map marker system. Added privacy and compass visibility settings
- Fixed various bugs with electric plugs

Thank you for all the feedback! The team is hard at work preparing more fixes and improvements for the playtest. Stay tuned!
